newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania forex reserves slips to $1.848 bln in July.
newsitem.headline: Romania forex reserves slips to $1.848 bln in July.

text.p: Romania's foreign exchange reserves slipped slightly to $1.848 billion in July from $1.869 billion at end-June with the Balkan country making payments on its external debt, central bank (BNR) data showed on Tuesday.
Data on the BNR's own foreign exchange reserves were not available.
In July, Romania's foreign exchange assets were the equivalent of 2.4 months of imports, down from 2.5 in June.
FOREIGN CURRENCY RESERVES JULY JUNE JULY 95
NOTE: Romania's total foreign exchange reserve figure includes Special Drawing Rights holdings but do not include the country's gold reserves of around 87 tonnes.
